1. TS-OT-CONSTRAINED-001 — Compromise of a SICAM 8 RTU through the maintenance network
The attacker controls the maintenance laptop or uses compromised credentials. Through the established path, the attacker reaches the RUGGEDCOM RST2428P.
The attacker attempts to bypass the network-segmentation controls on the RUGGEDCOM RST2428P. The exact vulnerability used for this action could not be confirmed. The scenario assumes that the preceding step succeeds, allowing the SICAM 8 CPCI85 to become accessible.
The attacker then attempts to compromise the SICAM 8 CPCI85. The exact exploitation mechanism could not be confirmed.
The attacker may impair an operational control or communication function.

No evidence-backed actionable defense recommendation available.
